codeAssets.description: Runnable React example with Search Box, Search Results, and Chat

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant; if you already know the backend, you can configure it directly instead.
What topic do you know exists in your Glean content?

run.url: the Local URL printed by Vite

steps.title: Copy the React example onto your machine
steps.description: Creates an embed-search-chat folder in whatever directory you run this from. Every command after this one runs inside that folder.

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.description: Installs the pinned Glean Web SDK, React, and Vite dependencies.

steps.title: Find your Glean backend
steps.description: Uses your email once to find the tenant backend and writes VITE_GLEAN_BACKEND to .env.local. If the backend is already known, set that variable manually instead. This is setup-time configuration, not a runtime tenant picker, and it does not request or store an API key.

steps.title: Configure the Web app URL and questions
steps.description: Open .env.local. Set VITE_GLEAN_WEB_APP_URL to the exact value shown in Glean Admin > About Glean > Web app URL; keep backend and Web app URL as setup/deployment configuration rather than runtime user inputs. Set VITE_GLEAN_INITIAL_QUERY and VITE_GLEAN_INITIAL_MESSAGE to topics you know exist in your Glean content.

steps.title: Open the page
steps.description: Starts Vite and prints a Local URL. Open that URL in a browser where the user is signed in to Glean.

steps.title: Verify search, chat, and the user boundary
steps.description: Confirm autocomplete appears above Search Results, a known query returns accessible content with citations, and Chat answers the configured question. Repeat the check with a second authorized user and confirm neither Search nor Chat reveals content that user cannot access. If a vanity SSO hostname redirects an embedded frame to app.glean.com, confirm the exact Web app URL in Admin > About Glean; never proxy or frame the full app.

aiPrompt:
Embed Glean Search and Chat in my internal web app using the Glean Web SDK, following the recipe at https://developers.glean.com/cookbook/embed-search-chat. Ask for my work email and a topic I know exists before changing the app.

For an existing app:
1. Use the work email already supplied to resolve the Glean backend, or let the developer set the known backend directly.
2. Install the pinned SDK with npm install @gleanwork/web-sdk@2.4.0.
3. Ask for the Glean Web app URL from Admin > About Glean > Web app URL.
4. Use the browser SSO flow with authMethod: 'sso' and the user's signed-in Glean session. Add explicitly sized search-box and search-results containers with coordinated onSearch callbacks, and add a chat container with position: relative, display: block, width: 100%, and height of at least 480px. Pass the supplied topic as initialMessage.

If the app cannot install npm packages, use the current script-tag instructions from the Glean Web SDK documentation. For the shipped React variant, copy the recipe asset, install its pinned dependencies, run the configure command, set VITE_GLEAN_WEB_APP_URL in .env.local, and start Vite. Ask the user to open the printed URL in a browser where they are signed in to Glean. Verify Search autocomplete, permission-aware results with citations, Chat with citations, and the same checks as a second authorized user.
llmContext: Use @gleanwork/web-sdk 2.4.0 with the browser SSO flow: authMethod: 'sso', explicit backend and webAppUrl, and the signed-in user's permission-scoped session. Search requires coordinated renderSearchBox and renderSearchResults calls; both need onSearch, backend, webAppUrl, and explicit container sizing. Chat uses renderChat with the supplied initialMessage. The shipped React example uses React and Vite, resolves the backend during setup, and requires the exact Web app URL from Admin > About Glean. Live verification requires a signed-in browser session and a second authorized user.

content.problem:
Your team lives in an internal tool and context-switches to find answers.
Instead of sending them elsewhere, bring Glean's answers into the app they
already use — with permissions enforced per user, automatically.
takeItFurther: Hand off context between search and chat so a search result opens a grounded conversation ([separate pages for chat and search](/libraries/web-sdk/components/chat)).
Scope chat to a specific agent by passing its `agentId` to the chat component.
Add the [Modal Search](/libraries/web-sdk/components/modal-search) or [Sidebar](/libraries/web-sdk/components/sidebar) variants for search anywhere in the app.
